LESSON: D FORMS

Grade: PP1
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: CREATING
Topic 7.1: D forms

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about D forms. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Display the ability to operate the gadgets for creating shapes
2. Create shapes using electronic gadgets for creativity
3. Appreciate own created shapes for fun

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Display the ability to operate the gadgets for creating shapes
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to display the ability to operate the gadgets for creating shapes. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Create shapes using electronic gadgets for creativity
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to create shapes using electronic gadgets for creativity. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. Appreciate own created shapes for fun
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate own created shapes for fun. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about D forms.
2. Explain D forms to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: Guide learners to operate 1. What electronic gadget SHAPES AND shapes and forms leaner should be able to: electronic gadgets did you use to create FORMS USING ICT 5 lessons a) Interact with the gadgets freely
4. Show that you can: Display the ability to operate the gadgets for creating shapes
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about D forms. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is D forms important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

2. Create shapes using electronic gadgets for creativity
